topics.content:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS STUDIES
RELIGION STUDIES
FIRST AND SECOND TERM
WEEK 2
PRIMARY 1
THEME - THE GOODNESS OF GOD
PREVIOUS LESSON - Revision of Previous Class
TOPIC - ARABIC ALPHABETS
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Arabic Alphabet
3. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. pronounce the Arabic Alphabets correctly.
2. identify each of the alphabets.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
Some pupils can read and identify Arabic Alphabet.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. A cardboard on which the Alphabets are boldly written.
2. Flash cards.
3. Information technology devices.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - READ AND IDENTIFICATION
ا    ب   ت    ث    ج    ح   خ
د   ذ   ر   ز    س   ش   ص
LESSON 2 - IDENTIFICATION AND WRITING
ا    ب   ت    ث    ج    ح   خ
د   ذ   ر   ز    س   ش   ص
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Writes the alphabets boldly on board.
3. Pronounces the alphabets and asks the pupils to do so several times.
Pupil’s Activities - Listen to the teacher’s pronunciation attentively.
4. Uses flash card to guide pupils to recognise and identify it.
Pronounce the alphabets trying as much as possible to imitate their teacher.
5. Guides pupils to identify and write the alphabets.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify and write the alphabets.
6. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as the teacher writes.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
Arabic Alphabet Part 2 Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Islamic Religious Studies
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to -
1. Pronounce the arabic alphabets correctly.
2. Identify each of the alphabets.
